comparison.objective: Remove a terminal, versus install an O-ring into a plug groove.
comparison.physical_skill: Rigid blade-mediated latch release, versus controlled deformable stretching and untwisted seating.
comparison.success_condition: Terminal out without housing/crimp/neighbor damage; versus ring seated square and untwisted without exceeding the stretch limit.
comparison.reason: Extraction of a rigid latched component does not test deformable seal installation.
